header.title: Privacy Policy
header.lead: How we handle information a person chooses to share when contacting us or arranging a visit.

privacy.intro: This website is mainly informational. This policy describes the current practices of Jardín de Mariposas La Paz and may be updated when its activities or technologies change.

sections.heading: Site contacts and scope
paragraphs: Jardín de Mariposas La Paz is the site referred to in this policy. The people responsible for the site are shown at the end of this page.
This policy applies to information received through the website, WhatsApp, email or other direct contacts related to an enquiry or visit.

sections.heading: Data we may receive
paragraphs: When a person voluntarily contacts us to ask about or arrange a visit, they may provide information such as:
items: number of visitors and planned visit date;
school or group name, when applicable;
other information the person chooses to provide to arrange the visit.

sections.heading: How we obtain and use information
paragraphs: Information is obtained directly from a person when they write or call us. We use it to respond to enquiries, arrange visits, provide requested information, assist groups or educational visits, keep the communication needed for an enquiry or visit, support the security and technical operation of the website, and handle legal or privacy requests.

When appropriate, we seek or act on the person's consent for uses that require it, such as publishing photographs or testimonials. We do not send subsequent marketing communications without authorization.

sections.heading: WhatsApp enquiries and confirmation
paragraphs: Enquiries and visit arrangements are mainly handled on WhatsApp and answered manually by the people responsible for the site.
Sending a message does not automatically create a confirmed reservation. Availability must be confirmed directly by Jardín de Mariposas La Paz.

sections.heading: Retention and third parties
paragraphs: Information is kept only for the time reasonably necessary to answer the enquiry, arrange the visit and meet applicable obligations. Conversations or data that are no longer needed may be deleted periodically.
The site may link to or integrate external services such as WhatsApp, Facebook and Google Maps. When using those services, their providers' policies also apply.

sections.heading: Photographs, testimonials and communications
paragraphs: Photographs or testimonials are published only where authorization exists. If a WhatsApp message or comment is later intended for use as a review, authorization will be requested before publication.
People may ask for a photograph or testimonial to be reviewed through the published contact channels.

sections.heading: Your rights, security and changes
paragraphs: You may request access, correction or rectification, or deletion of your data when applicable, by writing to the official email or contacting the published telephone numbers. We seek to apply reasonable measures to protect information according to the nature of the contact.
We may update this policy to reflect changes in practices, services or applicable requirements. The update date will be shown on this page.

header.title: Terms of Use
header.lead: Basic terms for using this informational website and asking about a visit.

terms.intro: By using this website, you agree to use it lawfully and in accordance with these terms. The site does not offer customer accounts, checkout, online payment or automatic reservations.

sections.heading: Identity and purpose of the site
paragraphs: Jardín de Mariposas La Paz provides this website mainly for informational and promotional purposes about the butterfly garden, the visitor experience, hours, location and contact channels.
The information is intended to help plan a visit, but may require direct confirmation before travelling.

sections.heading: Enquiries, visits and availability
paragraphs: Enquiries are made on WhatsApp. An initial conversation does not guarantee availability; a visit is considered arranged when the people responsible confirm the details directly.
Current hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; Saturday, 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon; Sunday, check availability. We recommend confirming availability before travelling.

sections.heading: Prices, payment and changes
paragraphs: Price information is confirmed directly when you ask. Unless something different is agreed directly, payment for the visit is made at the butterfly garden.
There is no published formal cancellation policy. If you need to change or cancel an arranged visit, we recommend contacting us on WhatsApp as soon as possible.

sections.heading: Lawful use and content
paragraphs: You must not use the site in a way that interferes with its operation, harms others or infringes applicable rights.

Original content, photographs taken by staff and official materials may be protected. Some photographs and other materials belong to third parties and are used under applicable licenses or authorizations; third-party rights remain with their owners.

sections.heading: Links, information and changes
paragraphs: Links to external services are provided for reference. Their content and policies are the responsibility of their respective providers.
We seek to keep site information current, but hours, availability or other details may change. We may update these terms or the site when needed.

sections.heading: Applicable law and contact
paragraphs: These terms are interpreted in accordance with applicable Costa Rican law. For a question about the site or a visit, use the contact channels below.

header.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies Policy
header.lead: Transparency about the technical preferences the website currently stores.

cookies.intro: This policy describes technologies observable in the current website. A cookie banner has not been added because no non-essential tracking technologies have been identified in the website code.

sections.heading: Current local storage
paragraphs: The site uses browser local storage, not cookies, to remember two visitor-selected preferences:
items: jmlp-theme-v1: light or dark mode preference;
jmlp-motion-preference-v2: full or reduced motion preference.

sections.heading: Purpose and control
paragraphs: These preferences help preserve the selected appearance and motion experience when the site reloads. You can change both preferences through the visible controls on the site or clear local storage in your browser settings.

sections.heading: External services and infrastructure
paragraphs: The site may include external links or services such as WhatsApp, Facebook and Google Maps. When using them, their providers may apply their own technologies and policies.

Hosting infrastructure may use technically necessary mechanisms. Its actual operation must be audited during staging before publication on Hostinger; this policy does not state that no other infrastructure technologies exist.

sections.heading: Future technologies
paragraphs: If we add analytics, advertising, forms, newsletters or other similar technologies in the future, this policy will be updated before or when those tools are activated, as appropriate.

header.title: Photography and Image Rights
header.lead: How we distinguish rights in a photograph from the image rights of people shown in photographs.

imageRights.intro: This page explains current practices and the channels for requesting a review. It does not replace the licenses, authorizations or permissions that apply to each specific material.

sections.heading: Photographs and third-party materials
paragraphs: Some photographs have been taken by Jardín de Mariposas La Paz staff to document the space and visits. Other images belong to third parties and are used under applicable licenses or authorizations.
Rights in a photograph and the image rights of a person shown in it are different concepts. Third-party rights remain with their owners.

sections.heading: Required attributions
paragraphs: The following third-party images used on the website are attributed in a manner compatible with their Creative Commons licenses:

links.label: Morpho helenor peleides — Charles J. Sharp

sections.heading: People photographed and minors
paragraphs: Jardín de Mariposas La Paz seeks authorization before using visitor photographs on the website or social media.

When an identifiable minor is included in promotional material, we will seek authorization from a parent, mother or responsible representative before publication. Doubtful cases require internal review before launch.

sections.heading: Photos taken by visitors
paragraphs: Visitors may take photographs and record video during their visit for personal purposes and normally share them on social media. This policy does not seek to claim rights in photographs a visitor took.

sections.heading: Commercial use of official materials
paragraphs: Use of the name, visual identity, official materials or content belonging to Jardín de Mariposas La Paz for commercial or promotional purposes, including use to promote other butterfly gardens, butterfly sales, chrysalis sales or related activities, requires prior authorization.
You may request it through the official email or WhatsApp.

sections.heading: Requests for review
paragraphs: If you believe you appear in a photograph, that material you authored is being used, or that there is a rights issue, you may write to the official email or contact the published telephone numbers to request a review. Each request will be reviewed; we do not promise automatic removal without that review.
